args.reason: The workspaceSettingsSchema applies .toLowerCase() to the webhookUrl field at line 46. When an admin saves workspace settings, this transforms the Zapier webhook URL from 'https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/AbCdEfG/' to 'https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/abcdefg/', changing the case-sensitive path component 'AbCdEfG' to 'abcdefg'. Zapier's webhook URLs are case-sensitive, so the lowercased URL returns 404 'hook not found' even though the original URL still exists in Zapier's dashboard.

answer.overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that normalizing the webhook URL to lowercase would preserve its validity, but Zapier webhook URLs contain case-sensitive path segments that become invalid when lowercased.
answer.why_it_breaks: The validation schema applies .toLowerCase() to the webhookUrl field (line 46), which transforms the case-sensitive Zapier URL from 'https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/AbCdEfG/' to 'https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/abcdefg/', causing Zapier to return HTTP 404 because the path segment 'abcdefg' does not match the registered hook 'AbCdEfG'.
